implementation_identity: official chronos-forecasting package (PyPI 2.3.2) Chronos2Pipeline, frozen public checkpoint amazon/chronos-2, no fine-tuning; not Chronos-T5, Chronos-Bolt, or any synth/small variant
paper_reference: Amazon. Chronos-2: The Time Series Forecasting Model for the Agentic Era. arXiv:2510.15821, 2025

weights.sha256: see weights/weight_identities.json in the run worktree (recorded at download, 2026-10-23)

input_mapping.history_values.price: un-standardized once via frozen train target mean/std -> raw RRP target series [72]; model output is raw RRP (single inverse at input)
input_mapping.history_values.demand: past-only covariate demand_std [72] (standardized units retained; no inverse constants exist in shared metadata)
input_mapping.future_calendar: future covariates cal_0..cal_9 [24]; future keys subset of past keys, satisfied exactly
input_mapping.unmapped_reason: official API has no static covariate slot; future-only covariates require a history span which the public cache does not contain and inventing history is forbidden
input_mapping.scope_declaration: input_scope=restricted_price_target_demand_past_covariate_calendar_past_future; NOT an equal-input comparison to full-1465-column models

output_quantiles.source: native trained quantile head; checkpoint trained on 21 levels [.01,.05,...,.99] including all five common levels (verified from config.json revision 29ec3766); no interpolation, extrapolation or endpoint copying

native_behavior.padding: context exactly 72; no padding needed; only official left-padding would apply for shorter histories

context_policy.context_source: each origin's own legal 72h price history plus covariates known at that origin
context_policy.test_labels: never visible to the adapter; scorer-only

randomness.seed_controls: nothing; frozen weights, no sampling, deterministic kernels given hardware; the three formal seeds reuse the verified deterministic output via the recorded reuse path
randomness.same_conditions_repeat: bitwise stable within a fixed device/batch; batch-composition invariance is checked in stage 2 with a declared tolerance

differences_from_paper: paper evaluates zero-shot on its benchmark suites, not AEMO NEM hourly prices; covariate subset restricted to what the shared cache can legally supply; no benchmark score reproduction claimed
